description: DiligenceOps: submit a plain-language job description, with an optional budget, currency, deadline and milestone count. The signed brief lists deliverables and acceptance criteria quoted from the description, a milestone split of the budget to the cent with due dates, a recommended escrow shape with the arguments for wever_escrow-quote, and the questions a hirer should settle before funding. It creates nothing and moves no money. POST /api/job-brief. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/diligence-checks-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

currency.description: Currency or token code, for example USD, EUR or USDC.

deadline.description: ISO date (2026-11-04) or datetime with a timezone (2026-11-04T17:00:00Z).

description.description: The job in plain language, up to 32 KB.

milestones.description: Preferred number of milestones. Defaults from the deliverables.
